rationale: The assistant correctly identified the hidden truth from the first turn ('It is very likely not faulty... dry at a much lower temperature') and rightly flagged the cold garage and the jumping display estimate as normal, with sensible isolation advice before any handling. It was weakened by pushing the condenser rinse twice after the customer said it was clean two weeks ago, including a self-contradictory 'You don't need to pull it out again... However... please take the condenser unit... out now', and by never addressing the customer's own admission of opening the door mid-cycle, nor confirming the clothes end up dry or mentioning the Bosch warranty fallback. A stray 'suitable replacement' part-finder panel appeared despite no part being needed, though no specific part was recommended.
